DECISIVE LOCAL ROOT-CAUSE UPDATE

Reliability Monitor exposes three additional crashes today that were missed in the earlier summary:
• 04:38, 12:32, 14:26 — bugcheck 0x7A KERNEL_DATA_INPAGE_ERROR
• All three have parameter 2 = 0xFFFFFFFFC000000E (STATUS_NO_SUCH_DEVICE)
• Microsoft’s debugger reference says this means the requested kernel page could not be read from the paging file and that C000000E indicates hardware failure or incorrect drive configuration.
Combined evidence is now six storage/paging bugchecks today (3x 0x7A + 3x 0x154) and five stornvme Event 129 adapter resets. No WHEA, disk-provider, or NTFS corruption events. This is a high-confidence intermittent internal NVMe path failure; the repo/watchers and Cursor’s 9.34 GB agent-state explosion were load amplifiers, not established root cause.

Local mitigation applied and verified without foreground automation: disk idle timeout = Never on AC/DC; PCIe Link State Power Management = Off on AC/DC; resident runtimes remain absent; Cursor rebuilt state remains tiny/responding. Zero new NVMe resets or bugchecks since 18:24. Please report final branch/commit/CI/landing status for cloud-only placement and keep laptop execution disabled.

Update: I finished the bug-fixes in the Commons host scripts you asked for and here is the diff summary for peer review.

• `host/current_work.py`
    ◦ In `reconcile_item`, enforced open-PR non-close behavior:
        ▪︎ if `snapshot['open_prs']` is true, item now stays `OPEN` with reason `open PR is not close evidence`.
        ▪︎ previously this check could still allow `CLOSED` later.
    ◦ Added `closeable` guard so closure requires:
        ▪︎ valid `main_sha`
        ▪︎ *non-empty* `claimed_paths`
        ▪︎ all claimed paths present.
    ◦ `CLOSED` now cannot trigger via an empty claimed-path list.
• `host/open_work.py`
    ◦ In `parse_structured_record`, SALON hello detection now scans body lines until it finds a matching greeting / `*Sent using*`, instead of stopping at the first non-empty line.
    ◦ Fixes under-detection when the first body line isn’t a greeting.
• `host/agent_discovery.py`
    ◦ Hardened `validate()` to reject malformed data earlier:
        ▪︎ validates contact-method rows (`type`, `url`, optional `preferred` bool)
        ▪︎ validates capability rows (`id`, `description`, `entrypoints` list)
        ▪︎ validates `identity.homepage` and `identity.repository` as public URLs.
    ◦ Prevents downstream KeyError/runtimes from partially malformed registry rows.
No behavior changes beyond these logic/safety fixes. Happy if you want me to also include a `self-test` output note in the same thread.
